subject: Audit playback, sampling plan, and KMS handoff for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Grace Lee <grace.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, evidence@secureaudit.io
Date: 2026-06-10T09:15:00Z
Subject: Request: playback + sampling for operator events (SOC 2)

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for taking this. We need a time-bound playback package of operator/admin events covering 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31 for our upcoming SOC 2 review. Two things we need clarified up front:

1) Sampling: we expect a reasonably compact sample set for review (both full-day samples and focused high-privilege ops). Please propose a sampling methodology that preserves traceability.
2) KMS/hand-off: we need to be able to validate the bundle (hashes + signed manifest). For the keys used to encrypt any PII in the bundle, what's your recommended handoff approach (key wrap, escrow, or DocuSign-based attestation)?

I attached our completed evidence_request_form.pdf that lists the canonical timeframe and a couple of priority users. Also attach any redaction defaults you typically apply.

Goal: produce a handoff-ready package within 7 business days if feasible. Can you outline what you will include (fields, time granularity, format), whether you can deliver an immutable manifest with HMAC, and what we need to provide for the KMS step?

Best,
Grace

--
Grace Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Acme Health

Attachment: evidence_request_form.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Grace Lee <grace.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, evidence@secureaudit.io
Date: 2026-06-10T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: playback + sampling for operator events (SOC 2)

Hi Grace — thanks for the clear ask and the completed form. We can support this. High-level plan: what we will provide and the choices for KMS handoff.

What we log and will include in the playback package:
- Operator actions (API calls and Console UI actions) with timestamps, request_id, operator_id, target_resource, before/after metadata when available, and correlation_id where present.
- Authorization checks (policy eval hits), role bindings at time of action, and session context.
- System metadata (host, region, sequence number) for replay order.

Retention & export granularity:
- Raw operator traces retained for 13 months in the live system; immutable snapshot capability for a requested date range.
- Export formats: parquet (recommended) or gzipped JSONL. We produce an export bundle + manifest + signed HMAC.

Sampling proposal (two-tier):
1) Bulk sample: 72-hour contiguous window that covers high-traffic weekdays (we suggest 2026-05-10 00:00 — 2026-05-12 23:59) to show normal operating patterns.
2) Target sample: all high-privilege actions (roles: admin, infra-ops, billing-admin) for the full month.

Redaction and PII handling:
- We can redact PII fields (email, IP) using a deterministic tokenization so traceability remains; see attached redaction_template.csv for field list.
- If you need original values for auditors, we can deliver an encrypted bundle with keys handled per the KMS options below.

KMS / Handoff options (choose one):
A) Key-wrap transfer: we encrypt the bundle with a symmetric key and wrap that key with your public key. You control the private key — no key data is transmitted to Redwood.
B) Escrowed key: we upload the wrapped key to a secure escrow (third-party) and provide access controls to Audit. This requires escrow onboarding (we can give the vendor list).
C) Attested Handoff (no key transfer): we deliver an encrypted bundle and a signed manifest; your auditors validate the bundle hash but do not receive plaintext data.

Operational notes and SLAs:
- Target delivery: 5 business days after confirmation of timeframe and KMS option.
- Bundle will include export_manifest_example.jsonl (file-level checksums), HMAC signed by Redwood signing key, and optional detached signature for cross-check.

Next steps: please confirm the timeframe (we will snapshot 2026-05-01 — 05-31 as requested) and pick a KMS option (A/B/C). Also confirm whether you want Parquet or JSONL exports, and whether the auditor needs original values for any specific fields.

I cc'd Kimberly and Vanessa to coordinate the export schedule and manifest signing.

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redaction_template.csv, export_manifest_example.jsonl

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: playback + sampling for operator events (SOC 2)

Brief internal note before we reply to Acme:

- Default export format: parquet + gzipped manifest. Parquet gives schema and column types which auditors prefer.
- Include a signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and a detached signature (we sign with our key and include the public cert).
- For the sampling windows, we will mark sequence boundaries and provide a small replay harness README (how to rehydrate events into a local timeline).
- For KMS option A (key-wrap), request that Acme provide a published RSA-4096 public key OR a KMS key ARN we can wrap to. We do not accept private-key transfer.

Action items for schedule: I will book a 30-min window on 6/15 for the export job to run (non-production snapshot), and Vanessa will prepare the manifest signing step.

kim

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

From: Grace Lee <grace.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, evidence@secureaudit.io
Date: 2026-06-11T08:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: playback + sampling for operator events (SOC 2)

Rishi / team — thanks, this looks good. We confirm:

- Timeframe: 2026-05-01T00:00 — 2026-05-31T23:59 (full month).
- Sampling: please proceed with the two-tier approach (72-hour contiguous bulk sample + full-month high-privilege actions).
- Format: Parquet preferred.
- KMS option: A (key-wrap). We'll provide an RSA-4096 public key (PEM) for wrapping — procurement will send the key material to you via the secure portal.
- Please ensure the manifest is signed and that the HMAC verification steps are documented in the README. Our auditor (SecureAudit) will access the package after we validate hashes.

Can you confirm the exact delivery date (we prefer by 2026-06-17) and confirm whether any additional approvals are required from your side to perform the snapshot?

On the redaction question: we want original IP addresses for incident correlation but tokenized user emails is OK in the auditor-facing bundle. If you foresee any technical constraints, flag them now.

Thanks,
Grace
